name: mergado-skills
description: Mergado Claude skills marketplace — shared skills for working with Mergado Editor and product feeds.

plugins.name: mergado-asistent
plugins.description: Assistant for Mergado Editor users — translates real business problems (Google Shopping errors, missing colours, hidden products) into actions via the Mergado MCP.

plugins.name: ai-visibility-audit
plugins.description: Audits an online store's readiness to be discovered, cited and recommended by AI chat assistants and shopping agents. Combines a live probe of the public website with internal data from Mergado, Merchant Center and Search Console.

plugins.name: audit-projektu
plugins.description: Read-only logical and operational audit of a feed project across Mergado and its extensions (Pricing Fox, Bidding Fox, Feed Image Editor). 145 checks for data nonsense, name-versus-content contradictions, duplicate and dead rules and cross-app conflicts.

plugins.name: mergado-campaign-backup
plugins.description: Backs up the rules of a seasonal campaign (Black Friday, Christmas) together with notes on what worked, so last year's setup can be found before the next season. Runs on demand.

plugins.name: mergado-google-ads-optimization
plugins.description: Content and marketing optimization of a Google Shopping feed in Mergado. Diagnoses nine pillars, reports findings with their impact and, after approval, creates the corresponding Mergado rules.

plugins.name: mergado-heureka-optimization
plugins.description: Content and marketing optimization of a Heureka feed in Mergado. Diagnoses nine pillars including product pairing and CPC segmentation, and after approval creates the corresponding Mergado rules.

plugins.name: mergado-meta-optimization
plugins.description: Content and marketing optimization of a Meta (Facebook, Instagram) catalog feed in Mergado. Diagnoses nine pillars including custom_label segmentation and stock availability, and after confirmation creates the corresponding Mergado rules.

plugins.name: mergado-project-auto-backup
plugins.description: Backs up a Mergado project's rules, queries, variables and custom elements to JSON and registers itself as a recurring scheduled task with configurable storage, frequency and retention.

plugins.name: shoptet-feed-doctor
plugins.description: Validates, diagnoses and fixes Shoptet product feeds — local RNG validation, decoding the misleading Shoptet validator messages, correct element placement for variants and merging standalone items into variants.
